business.headline: Bank FD or post office deposit? The higher interest comes with a catchHigher interest or easier access; which matters more? A look at the latest rates across different institutions shows why the highest rate may not always be the best choice.

What happens to your money between Saturday and Sunday? Bank strike today: Why are employees protesting, and will there be more strikes?Bank employees and officers joined a nationwide strike that disrupted public sector bank branches on Friday. NSE IPO to open on September 17: Check price band, GMP, crucial datesThe National Stock Exchange (NSE) will open its IPO on September 17 with a Rs 1,700-1,785 price band. The long-delayed listing brings a dominant market institution to investors while spotlighting its reliance on trading income.

Amid GDP credibility debate, IMF backs India's statistical reformsJulie Kozack, Director of the Communications Department at the IMF, said the latest GDP release incorporated the two new statistical series and described their inclusion as an important step towards strengthening India's macroeconomic statistics.

Four-day disruption looms as bank staff strike across India todayBank employees' unions will observe a nationwide strike on Friday over a five-day working week and other pending demands. The action could affect branch transactions across several states and may be followed by another strike later this month.

AI may reshape jobs, but India can turn the shift into an opportunity: CP GurnaniThe country can use AI to improve skills, build affordable solutions and create new opportunities, CP Gurnani, Co-Founder and Vice Chairman of AIONOS, said at the India Today BRICS Roundtable in New Delhi.

From groceries to investments AI agents could soon make payments for youUnder the proposed system, AI agents could make payments for users based on instructions given to them, reducing the need for people to approve every transaction separately.

Virtual trade corridors could boost BRICS connectivity, says RITES chiefMithal said several global corridors are being explored or developed, but major infrastructure gaps still need to be addressed to make them fully operational.

Mumbai is not India's biggest spender. These cities spend more per householdA new report on India's urban economy finds that the cities where households spend the most are not necessarily the country's biggest metros. In fact, none of the top five cities by average household spending is among India's six megacities.

Sensex ends 138 points higher, Nifty nears 23,500; Axis Bank up 2%The BSE Sensex opened at 74,742.54 and closed at 74,902.59, gaining 138.36 points, or 0.19%. The Nifty 50 opened at 23,446.60 and ended at 23,477.80, up 46.30 points, or 0.20%.

Sanctions are a joke: Businessman on how trade continues with sanctioned economiesBusinessmen and industrialists said sanctions may create additional compliance and logistical challenges for businesses, but they do not necessarily stop commercial activity.

entertainment.headline: Fall 2 Deadpoint review: A terrifying climb that loses its footingRelease Date:Sat Jul 11, 2026 While Fall 2: Deadpoint succeeds in delivering nerve-shredding vertical terror and solid lead performances, the survival thriller struggles under the weight of unnecessary plot twists. Changing the location offers fresh thrills, but overcomplicating a simple premise ultimately costs the film its emotional footing.

Made in Korea Season 2 review: Hyun Bin returns to a darker, messier game of powerRelease Date:Wed Sep 09, 2026 Made in Korea Season 2 brings Baek Gi-tae back to Seoul as a stronger player after President Park's assassination upends the order. The opening episodes widen the conflict into a tense battle over family, power and succession.

She's playing an extension of herself: Producer Mark Swift on H.E.R. playing Jo Producer Mark Swift said American singer-songwriter H.E.R. feels like an extension of Jo in Forgotten Island. The role has also let the singer explore her Filipino identity and a long-held animation dream.

It's all rumours: Hanuman Ansh producer dismisses Rs 100 crore OTT deal rumours Hanuman Ansh producer Ragini Sona denied reports of a Rs 100 crore OTT deal and called the claims rumours. The Neem Karoli Baba film continues its strong theatrical run and has crossed Rs 200 crore worldwide.

Rohit Roy terms TV a 'dustbin medium', slams actors' lack of 'dignity' and 'grace' Actor Rohit Roy called television a dustbin medium and said films are for posterity. He also linked the gap between television and film actors to how they carry themselves in public.

Bigg Boss 20: Uditi Singh on Karan Wahi breakup, marriage talks and wildcard buzz Bigg Boss 20 contestant Uditi Singh spoke about her past relationship with Karan Wahi and their breakup. She said she has long moved on and would treat him like any other contestant if he entered the show.

Hanuman Ansh earns Rs 200 crore on Rs 2-crore budget; beats Mirzapur, Haiwaan Director Vishal Chaturvedi's devotional drama Hanuman Ansh has crossed Rs 200 crore at the box office after a slow start. The Rs 2 crore film is now the number one title in India, outpacing Mirzapur The Movie and Haiwaan.

Ameesha Patel's staff member arrested over Rs 5 lakh theft at Mumbai residence Actor Ameesha Patel's manager has confirmed the arrest of a household staff member following a police complaint over jewellery worth Rs 5 lakh missing from her family's Mumbai residence.

Singer Amaal Mallik calls out Salman Khan Films over credit omission in Hero post Music composer and singer Amaal Mallik publicly questioned actor Salman Khan's production company for celebrating a song from the 2015 film Hero without crediting its composer and lyricist. The outburst has renewed focus on how creators are acknowledged as Amaal steps back from film music.

Producer Pranay Reddy Vanga challenges critics to 'kill' Prabhas-Triptii's Spirit Producer Pranay Reddy Vanga has openly challenged film critics ahead of Spirit's release. He urged them to target the Prabhas-starrer in theatres following mixed reviews for his latest production, Romanchakam, and ongoing casting developments.

Beyond star power: Is Hindi cinema entering a film-first era? The contrasting runs of Hanuman Ansh, Mirzapur: The Movie, Saiyaara, and Dhurandhar 2 have sharpened the debate over what draws Hindi audiences to theatres. This raises the question whether stars still matter, or whether films now need a stronger proposition of their own.

Akshay-Saif's Haiwaan earns Rs 3 crore on Day 1 amid Mirzapur, Hanuman Ansh wave Director Priyadarshan's crime thriller Haiwaan, featuring actors Akshay Kumar and Saif Ali Khan, started its theatrical run with Rs 3 crore nett. Day 1 occupancy gained momentum through evening shows amid ongoing competition from Mirzapur: The Movie and Hanuman Ansh.

Does Tamannaah Bhatia's Chhathi Maiya song get Chhath right, or is it too Bollywood? People from Bihar and Jharkhand compared The Vvaan's Chhathi Maiya with Chhath Puja traditions. They said the song captures the festival's devotional spirit but takes cinematic liberties with key details.

Is Ranabaali set in real life? The story of the Great Madras Famine of 1876-78 What is Ranabaali all about? Is Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna's film based on a real story? The story places Deverakonda's warrior in famine-hit Rayalaseema under British rule. The film appears to fictionalise real famine-era suffering and local resistance into a period action drama.

Bigg Boss 20 Episode 6: Kanika Mann-Yung DSA fight turns ugly over washroom row Captain Yung DSA and Kanika Mann's fight over duties and washroom use dominated episode six. The fallout pulled in other housemates, led to a ration cut, and ended on an emotional note.

Ajith thanks CM Vijay for visiting Silverstone, hopes India hosts Le Mans Cup. Video Ajith Kumar said C Joseph Vijay will visit Silverstone on Saturday after his team invited him to the Le Mans Cup round. The visit comes amid Tamil Nadu's push to promote sports and reflects Ajith's hope of bringing major motorsport events to India.

Nani confirms no trailer for The Paradise, refuses to call it a pan-India film Nani says The Paradise will release without a trailer, calling it a "beautiful mother-son story" rather than just an action drama. He also doesn't want to label it a "pan-India" film, with Telugu remaining the team's primary focus.

Anushka Sharma-Virat Kohli may make cameos in Hanuman Ansh sequel: Producer Hanuman Ansh is getting bigger with a sequel that could explore Neem Karoli Baba's famous devotees, including Anushka Sharma and Virat Kohli. Producer Namrata Singh opened up about all the other possible cameos the film could have.

Video review: Plenty of thrills in this eerie but imperfect Kannada horror filmRelease Date:Fri Sep 11, 2026 A found-footage horror that delivers thrills, but can't sustain its mystery when it matters most. The 122-minute film benefits from strong camerawork, editing and sound design, even as some screenplay choices and the climax hold it back.

PM Modi holds hands with Putin, Xi in striking photo from BRICS SummitThe moment comes against the backdrop of India's efforts to strengthen ties with both Russia and China while maintaining its strategic partnerships with other major powers.

The meeting stood out as Iran and the UAE kept diplomatic channels open amid recent regional tensions.

The day's agenda includes a closed-door session on inclusive global governance and strengthening multilateralism, a visit to the Bharat Innovates Exhibition, the leaders' family photo and joint tree plantation, followed by a gala dinner hosted by Prime Minister Narendra Modi at 7:30 pm. The schedule comes a day after PM Modi and Russian President Vladimir Putin agreed to deepen bilateral ties, while BRICS finance chiefs pushed for reforms to global development financial institutions.

How a Vajpayee-era shift lets Delhi-voter Raghav Chadha represent Punjab in Rajya SabhaBJP Rajya Sabha MP Raghav Chadha's return to Delhi's voter rolls has raised questions over how he can continue representing Punjab in the Rajya Sabha. The answer lies in an Atal Bihari Vajpayee-era amendment that abolished the state-residency requirement for Upper House candidates. The change was later upheld by the Supreme Court despite concerns that it weakened the Rajya Sabha's federal character.

Bittu Tabahi who cleaned river on his own shares his next step after Dutch job offerAfter receiving a job offer from The Ocean Cleanup, Bittu Tabahi asked followers which state he should clean next. The appeal has shifted attention from his work on the Ajnar River to wider pollution concerns across India.

Condemn in strongest terms: BRICS statement's special mention of Pahalgam attackThe BRICS declaration described acts of terrorism as criminal and unjustifiable, regardless of their motive or who carried them out. It reaffirmed their commitment to combating terrorism in all its forms, including the cross-border movement of terrorists, terror financing and safe havens.

The grouping also reiterated its commitment to the peaceful resolution of international disputes through dialogue, consultation and diplomacy.

China's No. 2 is in India. Meet Xi Jinping's powerful, secretive aide Cai QiCai Qi, widely seen as China's second-most powerful leader and Xi Jinping's right-hand man, is on his first visit to India. A secretive figure, Cai Qi has garnered considerable attention with his visit.

sports.headline: BCCI weighs match availability as new criterion for awarding central contracts The BCCI is considering making match availability a criterion for central contracts, with players potentially required to meet a minimum threshold. Lewis Hamilton crashes into a barrier during final Spanish GP practice: Video Lewis Hamilton crashed his Ferrari during final practice for the Spanish Grand Prix, damaging the car and bringing the session to a halt. With overtaking expected to be difficult in Madrid, the seven-time world champion faces a crucial qualifying session.

Supriya's hat-trick vs Korea powers India storm into Junior Women's Asia Cup final Supriya scored a penalty-corner hat-trick as India beat South Korea 5-1 in the Junior Asia Cup semi-final. The holders are now one win away from defending the continental title.

Back on duty, Bumrah gives Sooryavanshi a stern examination in DelhiAfghanistan vs India, T20Is: Fresh from a long injury layoff, Jasprit Bumrah looked anything but rusty at the Kotla, relishing every over as he tested Vaibhav Sooryavanshi in the nets ahead of India's T20I series against Afghanistan.
